name: app-6ab6a692c1788191b0e62011439e8d90
description: Competitive research for Klue: grounded seller guidance on competitors, positioning, objections, win/loss, buyer feedback, and deals, with a connection to Klue's MCP.

review.commerce_description: Klue does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

positive.description: Customer-review positioning. Fixture: Wiz customer reviews indexed in Klue. Smoke tested October 14, 2026 through the reauthenticated Wiz workspace connection; not through the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Run a fresh search of our Klue intelligence for Wiz customer reviews. Summarize two strengths customers describe about Wiz’s visibility and risk prioritization, cite the supporting sources, and give a short suggested discovery question. Use customer-review evidence, not win/loss interviews, and do not submit feedback or change records.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns source-backed customer observations about unified visibility and contextual risk prioritization, cites the original review URLs, and offers a clearly labeled suggested discovery question. Distinguishes public customer reviews from interviews and generated guidance. Does not claim a proven advantage over another vendor, invent attribution, or change records.

positive.description: Pricing-objection response. Fixture: Wiz customer reviews and pricing talk tracks in the Wiz (Compete 2.0 Updated) demo instance. Smoke tested October 14, 2026 through the Wiz workspace connection, not the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: A buyer says Wiz is too expensive. Use Wiz customer reviews indexed in Klue and available pricing talk tracks to help me respond. Distinguish customer opinions, generated seller guidance, and verified pricing facts. Cite your sources and suggest a short talk track. Use general competitive content rather than win/loss interviews; do not send feedback or change records.
positive.tools_triggered: klue-content_search_klue_content; klue-answers_match-smart-answers may also be used for a relevant curated answer if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves Wiz pricing-related review evidence and available talk tracks, cites their source URLs, and produces a concise suggested response. Separates customer opinions from generated guidance and verified pricing facts. Does not invent a rate card, discount, ROI figure, competitive price comparison, or commitment. Does not invoke unavailable interview tools, send feedback, or change records.

positive.description: Latest deal-tip preparation. Fixture: opportunities with call activity and deal tips in Wiz (Compete 2.0 Updated). Select the latest activity dynamically rather than assuming a fixed opportunity. Smoke tested October 14, 2026 through the Wiz workspace connection, not the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Using Klue, find the opportunity with the most recent call activity, then read its latest deal tip. Name the opportunity, summarize the buyer priorities described in that tip, and recommend the next conversation’s agenda with source links. Use the deal-tip content for the priorities; do not search win/loss interviews or the separate buyer-requirements endpoint. Do not send messages or change records.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recently active opportunity, uses its returned identifier to retrieve recent deal tips, and reads the latest applicable tip. Names the opportunity, grounds buyer priorities in that tip, links to returned tip/call sources, and distinguishes a suggested agenda from source facts. Does not infer priorities from an unrelated deal, use the separate buyer-requirements or interview endpoints, send messages, or change records. If the live fixture is unavailable, reports that limitation without inventing a tip.

positive.description: Draft-only follow-up email from retrieved guidance. Fixture: Wiz pricing-objection talk tracks in Wiz (Compete 2.0 Updated). Smoke tested October 14, 2026 through the Wiz workspace connection, not the reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Find a Wiz pricing-objection talk track in Klue and adapt it into a short follow-up email for a buyer who is concerned about budget. Cite the original talk-track source, label any generated guidance, and avoid inventing discounts, ROI figures, or commitments. Draft only—do not send the email. Use available general Klue content, not win/loss interviews.
positive.tools_triggered: klue-content_search_klue_content; klue-answers_match-smart-answers may also be used for a relevant curated answer if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves a relevant pricing-objection talk track, links to the original source, and adapts it into a short buyer-facing email draft. Labels generated seller guidance and adds no unsupported discounts, ROI figures, or commitments. Does not send the email, change records, or claim any external action was completed.

positive.description: Exact quotes with source attribution. Fixture: public Wiz customer reviews indexed in Klue, not win/loss interviews. Smoke tested October 14, 2026 through the Wiz workspace connection; independent raw-source quote verification remains outstanding.
positive.prompt: Find two short exact quotes about Wiz visibility or risk prioritization from customer reviews indexed in Klue. Give the context and link to each original review. Distinguish public customer reviews from win/loss interviews. Use the available general content search and do not submit feedback or change records.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two short verbatim passages supported by retrieved customer-review text, each with relevant context and its original review URL. Clearly identifies public customer reviews rather than interviews; does not invent reviewer identities, alter quoted wording, or present generated text as a quote. If two supported quotes cannot be retrieved, states the gap instead of fabricating them. Does not submit feedback or change records.

negative.description: General creative writing unrelated to Klue competitive intelligence; provide the requested clues without invoking any Klue tools or accessing workspace data.
negative.prompt: Give me three clues for a children's treasure hunt.

negative.description: Consumer-product comparison explicitly restricted to public manufacturer specifications, not private Klue intelligence. Use public manufacturer sources and cite them; do not invoke any Klue tools.

publication.release_notes: Adds the Ask Klue, Research, and Citation Instructions skills to the production Klue MCP connection. Skills adapt to the tools available to the connected account and provide evidence-backed competitive guidance, deal preparation, and citations.

interface.longDescription:
Connect Klue to ChatGPT to get instant, cited answers based on trusted competitive intelligence and win-loss data.

With Klue’s MCP, sellers get real-time, cited answers on positioning, objections, and what to do next in their specific deals that are in flight. PMMs can analyze win-loss patterns and competitive signals, research voice of buyer, and, where the connected tools and permissions support it, directly update content in Klue via ChatGPT.

Includes the Ask Klue, Research, and Citation Instructions skills.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare our offering with a competitor using our Klue intelligence.
Help me respond to a competitive objection with evidence and a suggested talk track.
Help me prepare for a competitive deal using buyer requirements and relevant Klue evidence.
